Pilgrim Regulations

Guruvayur Temple Entry Rules & Dress Code Guidelines

Ensure a smooth and hassle-free darshan by observing the traditional dress code, security guidelines, and queue rules.

Advertisement
In-Article Content Ad (Responsive / Native In-Feed) AdSense Slot: In-Article Stream

Traditional Dress Code (Strictly Enforced)

Men's Dress Code:

  • Must wear a traditional Dhoti (Mundu) around the waist.
  • Shirts, banyans, vests, and t-shirts are strictly prohibited inside the inner courtyard.
  • An Angavastram (small shoulder cloth/towel) may be draped over the shoulder or chest.
  • Pants, jeans, Bermudas, shorts, or modern stitched lower garments are not permitted inside the sanctum.

Women's Dress Code:

  • Saree, Half-Saree (Pavada & Blouse), Set Mundu, or Chudidhar/Salwar Kameez with Dupatta.
  • Western wear, jeans, skirts, trousers, or tops without dupatta are strictly prohibited.

Children's Attire:

  • Young boys must wear a Mundu/Dhoti (or remain bare-chested with traditional wrap).
  • Young girls may wear traditional skirts (Pattu Pavada) or dresses.

Electronics & Prohibited Items

  • Mobile Phones & Cameras: Strictly prohibited inside the inner complex. Free and paid safe deposit counters (Cloak Rooms) operated by Devaswom are situated near East Nada.
  • Leather Articles: Belts with metal/leather, shoes, footwear, and leather pouches must be deposited at footwear counters outside.
  • Tobacco & Alcohol: Strictly forbidden. Smoking and chewing tobacco in the temple vicinity is punishable by law.
